g.text: The 11-Role Departmental Web & Access Affinity Board
Mapping operational personas, friction quotes, permission gates, and cross-department handshakes
"11 distinct roles shouldn't feel like 11 disconnected tools. By mapping
their exact permissions in Figma and vibe coding the route guards directly,
we created one cohesive operating cockpit where everyone stays in sync."
11-ROLE ACCESS ECOSYSTEM BOARD · SYNTHESIZING STAKEHOLDER FRICTION INTO TAILORED WORKSPACES
